保留最近 20 轮成功请求实际发给模型的词条。未携带的词条仍保存在完整术语库中。: Shows the exact terms sent in the last 20 successful requests. Unsent terms remain in the full glossary.
本轮没有匹配到相关术语。: No relevant terms matched this round.
下一轮翻译成功后，这里会显示实际发送的术语。: The terms sent will appear here after the next successful translation.
任务调度记录无法读取，请先导出任务备份，再清空本地数据: Task scheduling data cannot be read. Export a backup before clearing local data.
浏览器无法保存任务调度状态，已停止发送新请求，请先备份并清理本地数据: The browser could not save scheduling data. New requests have stopped. Back up your tasks and free up local storage.
任务已停止，请刷新后从保存的进度继续: The task has stopped. Refresh to resume from the saved checkpoint.
任务运行状态已改变，请重新开始: The task state has changed. Start it again.
任务已被删除，请先导出本页未保存的进度: The task was deleted. Export the unsaved progress from this page first.
任务已在其他标签页更新，请先导出本页未保存的进度: The task was updated in another tab. Export the unsaved progress from this page first.
请先暂停这个任务，再修改它: Pause this task before editing it.
这个任务正在运行或排队，请先暂停它；其他任务不受影响: This task is running or queued. Pause it first; other tasks are unaffected.
请先暂停所有正在运行或排队的任务: Pause all running and queued tasks first.
这个任务已经开始或正在排队: This task has already started or is queued.
任务已加入队列，空出名额后自动开始: Task queued. It will start when a slot is available.
已退出等待队列，继续时会重新排队: Removed from the queue. Resume to queue it again.
术语携带记录无效: The glossary request history is invalid.
本浏览器一次翻译一个任务，其余按顺序排队。不同使用者的队列互相独立。: This browser translates one task at a time and queues the rest in order. Each user has an independent queue.
其他标签页有活动任务。这里会同步进度，也可以暂停任务或将其他任务加入队列。: Other tabs have active tasks. Progress stays in sync; you can pause tasks or add others to the queue here.
已完成的译文可随时编辑，修改后自动保存: Completed translations can be edited at any time. Changes save automatically.
译文修改尚未保存: Translation changes are not saved yet
这条字幕尚未完成保存，请稍后再编辑: This cue has not finished saving. Try editing it again shortly.
这条译文已在其他标签页修改，草稿已保留，请核对后再保存: This translation changed in another tab. Your draft is kept; review it before saving.
任务进度已在其他标签页更新，请刷新后继续: Task progress changed in another tab. Refresh before continuing.
请完成当前译文输入后再导出: Finish entering the current translation before exporting.
随新进度自动定位；滚动、搜索或编辑不会取消勾选: Follow new progress automatically. Scrolling, searching, or editing keeps this option selected.
浏览器直连因跨域或网络问题失败，将尝试服务器转发: The browser connection failed due to CORS or a network error. Trying server forwarding.
优先由浏览器直连接口，不限制 API 域名。跨域或网络连接失败时自动改用服务器转: The browser connects directly first, with no API domain allowlist. CORS or connection failures switch to server forwarding, subject to this site's allowlist and rate limits.
直连时 Key 仅发送给模型接口；回退时会经过本站服务器，服务器不保存。: Direct requests send your key only to the model endpoint. Fallback sends it through this server, which does not store it.
API 地址必须使用 HTTP 或 HTTPS: The API URL must use HTTP or HTTPS.
此 API 地址不在服务器转发白名单中；请使用支持浏览器跨域的接口或联系部署者: This API endpoint is not on the server forwarding allowlist. Use an endpoint that supports browser CORS or contact the site operator.
单条译文不能超过 32000 字节，且不能包含空字符: A translated cue must be at most 32,000 UTF-8 bytes and contain no null characters.
风格备忘不能超过 6000 字节，且不能包含空字符: Style notes must be at most 6,000 UTF-8 bytes and contain no null characters.
术语原文、译文或备注过长，或包含空字符: The source term, translation, or note is too long or contains a null character.
已有译文，源语言和目标语言不能更改: The source and target languages cannot change after translation has started.
源语言和目标语言保持固定；调整分块只影响尚未完成的字幕。: Source and target languages stay fixed. Chunk changes apply only to untranslated cues.
模型输出需要包含有效的 translations 数组: The model output must contain a valid translations array.
本轮术语字段无效，已保留译文和已有术语库: The glossary field was invalid. Translations and the existing glossary were preserved.
本轮新增术语超过 40 条，已忽略超出部分并保留译文: More than 40 new terms were returned. Excess terms were ignored and translations were preserved.
本轮跳过 {0} 条无效术语，译文已保留: Skipped {0} invalid terms. Translations were preserved.
本轮跳过 {0} 条未在当前块原文中找到的术语，译文已保留: Skipped {0} terms not found in the current source chunk. Translations were preserved.
本轮风格备忘无效，已保留译文并沿用上一轮风格: Style notes were invalid. Translations were preserved and the previous style was retained.
读取时已忽略损坏的运行记录或统计，字幕与翻译断点已保留: Damaged activity records or statistics were ignored. Subtitles and translation checkpoints were preserved.
这个术语已在其他标签页删除，草稿仍保留，可备份或复制后重新添加: This term was deleted in another tab. Your draft is preserved; back it up or copy it to add the term again.
此内容已在其他标签页修改，草稿已保留，请核对后再保存: This content changed in another tab. Your draft is preserved; review it before saving.
有 {0} 条记录需要恢复，可在任务记录中下载原始数据: {0} records need recovery. Download their original data from Task history.
请完成当前术语或风格输入后再继续: Finish the current glossary or style edit before continuing.
有修改尚未保存: Some edits have not been saved
原始数据仍保留。下载后可修复并重新导入，其他任务可以正常使用。: Original data is preserved. Download it to repair and reimport it. Other tasks remain available.
删除后无法在本站恢复，请先下载需要保留的原始数据。: Deletion cannot be undone here. Download any original data you want to keep first.
